title: Chapter 93 Holy Land Of Immortals
content:
Chapter 93 Holy Land Of Immortals

With the appearance of the word "Zhen".

The pressure in the entire space suddenly increased at a rate of geometric times.

Countless spaces are densely packed with spaces.

In an instant, Gongsun Yao's screams sounded again.

"ah!!"

"Zhentian Seal, why do you have such a treasure?!"

Gongsun Yao heard a shrill and incredible voice from the field.

She didn't understand why the person in the lower realm in front of her could have such a treasure.

As far as she knows, it seems that there is no power behind her at this level.

Hearing Gongsun Yao's questioning, Lu Daosheng ignored Gongsun Yao and continued to activate the Tianshen Seal in the void.

At this moment, the size of the Tianshen Seal has become several times larger, and the name of the sky is absolutely worthy.

Facing the Tianzhan Seal, which even the Heavenly Dao could suppress, Gongsun Yao surrendered after just a moment.

"Stop quickly, stop quickly, I, I said,"

Buzz —

In an instant, all the pressure in the space disappeared directly.

Lu Daosheng appeared in front of Gongsun Yao and slapped Gongsun Yao's sky spirit cover with a palm.

The next moment, a strange rune appeared on Gongsun Yao's head. The rune gradually penetrated and finally merged into Gongsun Yao's soul.

Feeling the abnormality of the soul, Gongsun Yao looked a little desperate.

Because at this moment, her life was already in the hands of Lu Daosheng.

As long as Lu Daosheng thought about it, her soul would explode instantly.

"Now, it can be said."

At this time, Lu Daosheng said slowly.

Only in this way can he be relieved. After all, he is a cautious person.

And this guy's purpose is actually his daughter.

This is something he can't stand.

All dangers must be eliminated.

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Gongsun Yao put away his innocent face, and instead, his face looked extremely ugly.

"I hope you don't regret what happened today."

Gongsun Yao stared at Lu Daosheng with a vicious look and said in a deep voice.

However, what greeted her was the severe pain from the soul.

Looking at Gongsun Yao, who was curled up on the ground and rolling around due to severe pain, Lu Daosheng's face was also a little bad.

It's all like this, and he's still intent on threatening him.

Where does this come from cerebral palsy?

"Hurry up and let it go, don't talk nonsense."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Gongsun Yao sat on the ground with her eyes slightly red. This time, she was not pretending, but was really about to cry.

This is the first time she has suffered such a big loss in such a long time.

"My name is Gongsun Yao, I come from the Holy Land of Fairy Spirit, and I am the granddaughter of the Holy Lord of the Holy Land of Fairy Spirit."

At this time, Gongsun Yao spoke.

At this moment, she had given up resisting and made a fuss.

When Lu Daosheng heard about Gongsun Yao's identity, he was slightly surprised. It was another unknown place.

But he doesn't need to panic, after all, what's the point of panic?

Do you know what invincibility is?

"Then what is your purpose to approach my daughter?"

Lu Daosheng continued to ask.

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was not surprised or curious about his identity, Gongsun Yao was a little surprised, but due to Lu Daosheng's tyranny, she still honestly explained it.

"I, I feel your daughter Lu Xue has a deep luck. I just want to,"

"I want to win."

Before Gongsun Yao could finish speaking, Lu Daosheng answered directly for her.

Upon hearing this, Gongsun Yao lowered her head tightly and didn't say anything more.

Whether you die or live, let your destiny be.

Now, my life is in the hands of Lu Daosheng.

No one can save her.

No matter how terrifying the power behind him is, it doesn't make sense, unless his own people can kill Lu Daosheng directly without reacting.

Or, Lu Daosheng didn't kill her, she ran back secretly.

The strong people in the holy land will definitely be able to erase the marks on their souls.

But these success rates are too low.

She had already given up a little.

Unexpectedly, I would take care of myself when I came to this next trip.

Although the holy land will definitely avenge itself, how can one compare to the next generation?

Anyway, it's over if you lose a lot.

Now that she thinks about it, she regrets it very much.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's eyes at Gongsun Yao were already like a dead person.

The moment Gongsun Yao had thoughts about his daughter, Gongsun Yao's fate of dying was already destined.

To plunder other people's luck is no different from taking the other person's life.

Buzz —

Lu Daosheng raised his right hand expressionlessly, and a strange rune suddenly condensed from Lu Daosheng's hand.

As Lu Daosheng thought, the runes sealed on Gongsun Yao's soul suddenly emitted light.

"ah!!"

"Wait, my grandfather will definitely avenge me!"

Boom!

With the explosion sounded.

Gongsun Yao's entire soul burst out and she could not die any more.

Because of her carelessness and greed, she should have a perfect future and eventually died in the lower world where she looked down upon the most.

On the spot, Lu Daosheng patted the dust on his robe, and his face did not change at all.

Facing Gongsun Yao, whose power background is extremely mysterious and powerful, Lu Daosheng still did not hesitate. No matter who the other party is, if he dares to touch his relatives, death is the only result for the other party.

What's more, he has the ability to not fear any consequences.

Just kidding, the system is already like this. Are you still timid? Because the other party’s background is extraordinary, you can hold back. That doesn’t exist.

As long as the immortal spirit land dares to come, he will tell the other party that there will be no return.

.........

At the same time, on the top of a fairy-like mountain, an old man suddenly opened his eyes and looked suspiciously at the soul lamp beside him.

I saw that the soul lamp suddenly swayed for a moment, and the next moment, the soul lamp suddenly went out.

When the soul lamp goes out, it means that the person has died and is completely dead.

boom!

In an instant, a huge murderous intent surged out from the top of the fairy mountain, and the entire immortal spirit holy land felt this terrifying murderous intent.

At this time, a voice full of murderous intent and anger came from the top of the mountain.

"Dare to kill my Gongsun Sheng's granddaughter. No matter who you are, I will make you unable to reincarnate forever!!"

For a moment, countless practitioners in the holy land looked towards the direction of the immortal mountain in panic.

"What happened to the granddaughter of Lord Holy Lord!"

Several disciples looked at each other.

As we all know, their Holy Lord has two granddaughters. Except for the Saint who is in seclusion in the holy land, only Gongsun Yao is left.

The Saint will definitely not be a problem, so the one who happens must be Gongsun Yao.

Although they were not happy about Gongsun Yao's behavior, she was also the granddaughter of Lord Saint Lord after all.

Sure enough, countless powerful people filled with terrifying aura soared into the sky from all over the holy land and came towards the direction of the fairy mountain.

"Sir, Lord!"

Several powerful men with terrifying aura came to the fairy mountain and said respectfully to the old man.

The old man is the current holy lord of the immortal spirit holy land, Gongsun Sheng.

He is also Gongsun Yao's grandfather.

At this time, Gongsun Yao looked at the extinguished soul lamp with a ferocious expression, her whole body was trembling, and a stream of destructive aura continued to be recklessly.

"The lower realm is actually the lower realm!"

Gongsun Yao said furiously.

He couldn't believe that his granddaughter actually died in the lower realm.

In the lower realm, that is not a place where he can step into. Because of the rules, the stronger his strength, the greater his rejection will be.

With his current strength, it can be said that it is a fantasy to enter the lower realm.

However, there is no way to take revenge.

Then Gongsun Yao said with a grim voice: "Everyone, come with me!"

Suddenly, countless powerful people from the Holy Land of Immortal Spirits left the Holy Land of Immortal Spirits and headed towards the Land of Nothingness.

.........

On the other side.

Lu Daosheng, who had just destroyed Gongsun Yao, was about to leave when a special rune suddenly condensed from the void. The next moment, it flew straight into Lu Daosheng's body through layers of voids.

Feeling this, Lu Daosheng's face changed slightly.

This is?

[The host is a great master, this is the soul-chasing seal, which is a magical power of tracking. The general methods cannot be erased, but they do not affect the host is a great master]

Hearing the systematic explanation, Lu Daosheng suddenly realized.

It should be the means left by the forces behind the other party in Gongsun Yao's body.

Once killed, the opponent will know who did it, so as to facilitate revenge in the future.

With the ability of the system, it is naturally simple to remove this mark.

However, Lu Daosheng did not do so.

Want to take revenge?

Even if you come.

Lu Daosheng is not afraid now.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng left the space and returned to the deserted city.

This time, Lu Daosheng also gained a lot.

At least, he knew what he would face next.

The Holy Land of Fairy Spirits is unheard of. It is probably a higher-level world.

Immortal.

Is that the realm behind God?

Lu Daosheng shook his head, those are no longer important.

Anyway, as long as the other party comes, he will never hold back.

Because the opponent's strength is likely to be far higher than the world he is in now, no one can stop him except him.

Soon, Lu Daosheng appeared in the deserted city.

At this time, everyone in the deserted city was quietly waiting for Lu Daosheng.

"Sir, you are back."

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Qin Yi and others hurried forward and said.

At this time, Lu Xue and Luo Li also came back.

The two of them were smiling and obviously had a good conversation.

When Lu Daosheng saw Lu Xue's face suddenly turned happy.

"father!"

Hearing Lu Xue's shout, Lu Daosheng smiled and turned around and looked over.

"Xiaoxue, come here."

Lu Daosheng smiled and reached out his hand to move towards Lu Xue.
